summary: Create approval binds the exact title and goal; discussion replacement retains unanswered decisions and exported attachments retain byte checks. Pause and pending feedback survive ownership recovery and session transfer. Archive enforces current terminal evidence at the actual move; post-archive findings respect the selected repair scope. Workspace removal excludes queued, waiting and running workers through a shared run-admission interlock; cancellation previews remain read-only. The two human handoff Gates remain unchanged, with no repeated confirmation for already authorized direct work.
